title: Introducing Tessl Agent
description:
𝗧𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗹 𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝗻 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 𝗕𝗲𝘁𝗮.

AI coding agents are great at tasks you explicitly guide them through, but they rarely improve on recurring mistakes by themselves.

Tessl Agent continuously analyzes your pull requests, coding agent sessions, and issue tracker to identify repeated patterns. It automatically creates reusable skills, proposes GitHub Actions workflows, and opens pull requests so your development process keeps getting better without extra maintenance.

Instead of spending every sprint fixing the same issues, Tessl Agent helps your team build workflows that improve over time.
